_meta.description: Folds dunning (credit-control) and write-off (oninbaar) sub-concepts directly onto the existing ARInvoice schema. Adds an invoiceType discriminator (standard / credit-note / debit-note) plus a 'dunning' summary group (derived from the latest DunningRun for the invoice) and a 'writeOff' group (the full OninbaarAfschrijving field set). This is NOT an inheritance base — ARInvoice stays a primitive schema; these are additive properties only (version bumped). The migration FoldDunningWriteoffIntoArInvoice backfills writeOff/dunning from existing DunningRun and OninbaarAfschrijving rows. Source rows are NOT deleted.

invoiceType.description: Type discriminator on the AR invoice: 'standard' (a normal sales invoice), 'credit-note' (a credit correction — negative document referencing a prior invoice via precedingInvoiceReferences) or 'debit-note' (a debit correction). Folds the former separate credit/debit-note concept directly onto ARInvoice rather than a sub-schema.
invoiceType.title: Invoice Type

dunning.description: Credit-control dunning summary for this invoice, derived from the latest DunningRun targeting this factuurId. The per-stage DunningRun records remain the canonical history; this group is a denormalised at-a-glance summary maintained additively.

currentStage.description: Stage number (1–5 in the default ladder) of the most recent DunningRun executed for this invoice. Source: DunningRun.stageNr.
currentStage.title: Current Stage

nextDunningDate.description: Planned date the next dunning stage is due to be executed (ISO date). Computed by the credit-control scheduler; not carried on a historical DunningRun.
nextDunningDate.title: Next Dunning Date

collectionCostAmount.description: Incasso (collection) costs accrued as at the latest dunning stage (EUR). Source: DunningRun.incassokostenBedrag.
collectionCostAmount.title: Incassokosten Bedrag

interestAmount.description: Wettelijke rente (statutory interest) accrued as at the latest dunning stage (EUR). Source: DunningRun.renteBedrag.
interestAmount.title: Rente Bedrag

activeLadderId.description: FK to the DunningLadder currently applied to this invoice (after KlantLadderOverride resolution). Source: DunningRun.ladderId.
activeLadderId.title: Active Ladder ID

dunning.title: Dunning

writeOff.description: Bad-debt write-off (oninbaar afschrijving) group folded from the OninbaarAfschrijving schema. Present once an invoice has been written off; carries the art. 29 OB declaration, the eligible VAT teruggaaf and the materialised write-off GLTransaction. The OninbaarAfschrijving records are NOT deleted by the fold.

isWrittenOff.description: Whether this invoice has been written off as uncollectable (oninbaar). True once a write-off has been recorded.
isWrittenOff.title: Is Written Off

writtenOffReason.description: Categorised write-off ground, derived from the OninbaarAfschrijving.art29OBVerklaring declaration: bankruptcy (Faillissement), debt restructuring (Schuldsanering), one year unpaid (1jaar-onbetaald) or other (other).
writtenOffReason.title: Written Off Reason

art29OBDeclaration.description: Verbatim reason / declaration text underpinning the write-off (e.g. 'Faillissement vonnis 2026-04-12', 'Schuldsanering WSNP'). Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.art29OBVerklaring.
art29OBDeclaration.title: Art29Ob Verklaring

principalDepreciated.description: Principal amount written off, excluding VAT (EUR). Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.hoofdsomAfgeschreven.
principalDepreciated.title: Hoofdsom Afgeschreven

vatAmount.description: VAT amount eligible for teruggaaf per art. 29 OB (EUR). Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.btwBedrag.
vatAmount.title: BTW Bedrag

evidenceRef.description: FK URI to the supporting docudesk evidence (faillissementsvonnis, schuldsaneringsverklaring, etc.). Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.evidenceRef.
evidenceRef.title: Evidence Ref

writtenOffGLTransactionId.description: FK to the materialised GLTransaction recording the write-off booking. Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.boekingId.
writtenOffGLTransactionId.title: Written Off GL Transaction ID

vatRefundPeriod.description: VAT filing period the art. 29 OB teruggaaf has been queued for (e.g. '2026-Q2'). Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.btwAangiftePeriode.
vatRefundPeriod.title: BTW Teruggaaf Periode

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration carried through from the OninbaarAfschrijving record. Source: OninbaarAfschrijving.administrationId.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

writeOff.title: Write Off
